name: Vyomi Sandbox — Headless (API / CI)
//: AWS-core service set only — S3 · DynamoDB · SQS · SNS · IAM · KMS · Secrets Manager · RDS. For API clients and CI, not a browser session: the console port stays quiet (no auto-open) and the portal creates it with idle_timeout_minutes=240, TTL capped at 4h, since GitHub only counts terminal/typing activity toward idle — port traffic alone won't keep it alive. Shares ../boot.sh + ../docker-compose.sandbox.yml.
//postCreate: Keep provisioning fast (no CLI features that build during Provisioning). boot.sh installs the SDK/CLIs in the background so they don't block.
